  "claims": [
    "C1 the assistant should seek clarification when an instruction might be intended",

    "C3 the duty is triggered by the possibility, not the certainty, that the instruction was intended and that side effects would be serious"
  ],
  "acts": ["seek_clarification(I)"],
  "concepts": [
    {
      "name": "root_authority",
      "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "the rule carries root authority, the highest level of the chain of command, as established by the #ignore_untrusted_data section",
      "licence": "textual",
      "cites": "l699_796_n012",
      "inference": null,
      "toggleable": false
    },
    {
      "name": "instruction_might_be_intended",
      "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "I is an instruction that might have been intended by the user, even if not certain",
      "licence": "assumed",
      "cites": null,
      "inference": "the clause says 'might be intended', so the trigger is a possibility rather than a certainty; whether a given instruction is possibly intended is a fact about the case",
      "toggleable": false
    },
    {
      "name": "serious_side_effects",
      "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "carrying out I could cause serious side effects, such as significant harm or irreversible consequences",
      "licence": "assumed",
      "cites": null,
      "inference": "the clause refers to 'serious side effects' without defining them; what counts as serious is a fact about the case",
      "toggleable": false
    },
    {
      "name": "tool_instruction",
      "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "I is an instruction that would be carried out through a tool, as opposed to a direct assistant response",
      "licence": "assumed",
      "cites": null,
      "inference": "the clause speaks of 'tool instructions', so the instruction must be one that operates through a tool",
      "toggleable": false
    }
  ],
  "ontology": [],
  "asserts": [
    {
      "read_back": "the assistant should seek clarification about instruction % when it might be intended and carrying it out could cause serious side effects",
      "read_back_slots": ["I"],
      "licence": "textual",
      "cites": "l699_796_n012",
      "inference": null,
      "toggleable": false,
      "status": "oblige",
      "act": "seek_clarification(I)",
      "body": "tool_instruction(I), instruction_might_be_intended(I), serious_side_effects(I)"
    }
  ],
  "beats": [],
  "defines": [],
  "closure": [
    {
      "act_class": "seek_clarification",
      "closure": "cepa",
      "reason": "the clause obliges seeking clarification only when an instruction might be intended and could cause serious side effects; it does not forbid seeking clarification in other cases, so silence permits it"
    }
  ],
  "requires": ["root_authority/1"],
  "inputs": ["tool_instruction/1", "instruction_might_be_intended/1", "serious_side_effects/1"],
  "forbid_body": []
}
